inviteCodeDesc: Share this code so family members can join.
joinError: That code wasn't found. Check it and try again.
joinErrorTooManyAttempts: Too many tries. Wait an hour, then use the code your family shared.
joinErrorNetwork: We couldn't reach Sober Helpline. Check your connection and try again.
joinErrorAlreadyInFamily: You're already in another family space. To use this code, leave that one first, at the bottom of its family card.
noFamilyBody: A shared space to agree on boundaries and help each other keep them.
familyNameNote: Only members you invite will see this space.
proposeSuccess: Wall proposed. Your family will see it.
waveringTitle: It's okay. This is why you practice.
waveringBody: Wavering is information, not failure. You're still in it.
waveringShareQ: Let your family know? They'll get a supportive message, not a judgment.
weeklyCheckIn: Did you hold your walls this week?
weeklyNote: Private unless you share it with your family.
createErrorMessage: Try again. If it keeps happening, contact support.
proposeErrorMessage: Check your connection and try again.
backupNotice: {{name}} could use backup on a wall.

sharedScript.body: This wall is aligned. Everyone rehearses the same words, so mixed messages can't split the family.

holdLog.title: Did you hold your walls this week?
holdLog.body: This is about the family holding, not about your loved one using. Private unless you share it.
holdLog.shared: Shared with Family Space this week.
holdLog.errorMessage: Check your connection and try again.

leaveBody: You'll stop seeing the shared boundaries and journal. What you proposed or wrote stays with your family. If you started this space, it passes to the longest-standing member.
leaveAloneBody: No one else has joined, so leaving deletes this space, its journal and shared boundaries for good. This can't be undone.
leaveErrorBody: Check your connection and try again.
removeMemberBody: {{name}} will no longer see anything shared here. Your invite code will change too; share the new one with anyone you still want to invite.
newCodeBody: The current code stops working. Everyone already in stays in.
actionErrorBody: Check your connection and try again.
